name: agents
title: AI agent scope
summary: People decide what AI agents acting for them may do (off, read, suggest, edit) by default, per feature, per external service and per item; suggested changes arrive as notifications to accept or reject.

env.name: AGENTS_SUGGESTION_TTL
env.doc: How long a suggested change waits for the person before it expires (1h to 2160h).

env.name: AGENTS_MAX_PENDING
env.doc: Suggestions waiting per person, at most; agents are told to wait once it is reached.

env.name: AGENTS_SUGGESTIONS_PER_HOUR
env.doc: Suggestions agents may make for one person per hour.

env.name: AGENTS_SUGGESTION_RETENTION
env.doc: Accepted, rejected, failed and expired suggestions are deleted after this long (at least 24h).

wire.insert: import { agentsAdminNav, agentsResourceMenu, agentsSession, agentsSettings } from "./agents/registry";

stitch: Put a ⋮ ResourceMenu (web and mobile src/components/resource/ResourceMenu.tsx) on every feature section and resource screen, with feature, and kind + id for one item; the AI agent access row appears there by itself. External services pass feature connectors:<id>.

Give every write tool a Target (the one resource it changes) and a Preview (summary, before/after). A Target must return its kind even when the input has no id (agents learn which kinds a feature acts on by calling it with {}); otherwise declare them with agents.SetFeatureKinds. Tools without a Preview show their name and input.

Filter agent reads in features whose rows aren't access resources: when auth.AgentFrom(ctx) is set, drop rows with app.AgentAllows(…, app.AgentRead) (only FeatureLevel's max < AgentRead may skip the per-row check). Access resources narrow by themselves through access_level/access_visible with access.ViaAgent(ctx).

Turn on ASSISTANT_ALLOW_WRITES if suggest and edit should matter in the assistant (it never offers app write tools otherwise); MCP connections need the write scope for the same reason. External-service writes still ask the person in the assistant even at Edit.

Name modules that don't read well capitalised with agents.SetFeatureLabel ("crm" → "CRM") and add any write tool the word rule misses with agents.ForbidTool. Settings list content features only (mcp, moderation, notifications and search are hidden and keep the default level); adjust with agents.HideFeature / agents.ShowFeature.
Decide AGENTS_SUGGESTION_TTL, AGENTS_MAX_PENDING and AGENTS_SUGGESTIONS_PER_HOUR for how much agents should be able to queue.
Mention in the privacy policy that suggestions store the change an agent proposed (its input and a before/after preview) until they are decided and for AGENTS_SUGGESTION_RETENTION after.
